findings.location: Price text (e.g., '£51.77') and 'In stock' status labels
findings.recommendation: Darken the green shade to at least `#2e7d32` or `#1b5e20` to ensure the contrast ratio against the white background is at least 4.5:1.
Change the text color of the inactive breadcrumb item to a darker grey (such as `#595959` or `#767676`) to improve legibility.

findings.location: Product title links under book covers
findings.recommendation: Allow product titles to wrap to up to two lines before applying truncation, or use a consistent height container for the titles to maintain grid alignment.
Set `list-style: none` on the sidebar `<ul>` element and use modern CSS padding to align the text cleanly. Optionally, replace the standard bullets with a subtle custom chevron icon or indent.
